newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Bank stocks keep Mauritius bourse index stable.
newsitem.headline: Bank stocks keep Mauritius bourse index stable.

text.p: Rising shares in State Bank of Mauritius helped the Stock Exchange of Mauritius SEMDEX index edge up marginally by 0.14 points on Monday to 379.42, brokers said.
Turnover was posted at 3.87 million rupees on 256,882 shares from 4.91 million rupees on 227,419 shares on last Friday.

"The continuing subdued market sentiment reflects a natural behaviour from investors as there is a huge amount of money being invested on Port Louis Fund, Gamma Civic and Happy World secured bonds -- outside the stock market," a broker said.
State Bank of Mauritius gained 20 cents to 13.00 rupees on 137,300 shares while Mauritius Commercial Bank lost 50 cents to 89.00 rupees on 675 shares.

In tourism, Grand Baie Hotel was 2.00 rupees higher to 52.00 rupees on 17,400 shares. New Mauritius Hotels was unchanged at 38.00 rupees and Sun Resorts climbed 10 cents to 47.60 rupees but neither was traded.
Sugar-based Mon Desert Alma was 1.50 rupee lower at 82.00 rupees on 300 shares and Mon Tresor Mon Desert lost 40 cents to 38.50 rupees on 450 shares.
In the investment sector, Fincorp fell 1.50 rupee to 66.50 rupees on 1,000 shares and Mauritius Development Investment Trust was unchanged at 7.00 rupees on 18,524 shares.
Commerce conglomerate Rogers was stable at 92.00 rupees on 700 shares and Ireland Blyth Ltd was unchanged at 15.60 rupees but untraded. Air Mauritius eased 30 cents to 35.00 rupees on 1,346 shares.
